item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.27)] China May Greenlight Alibaba and ByteDance to Buy Nvidia's RTX Pro 5500

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.28)] Intel Stock Surged Over 40% in September. History Shows What's Next.
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.28)
Intel (NASDAQ: INTC) stock surged over 40% in September, making it one of the top performers in the S&P 500 for 2026 with a 250% year-to-date increase. However, the author warns that this rapid rally has made Intel's stock incredibly expensive, trading at 84 times this year's earnings and 62 times 2027's estimates. History suggests that such high valuations often lead to either substantial growth to justify them or a significant price correction, prompting investors to consider more reasonably priced alternatives like Taiwan Semiconductor or Nvidia.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (-0.12)] Hunting Nvidia AI chips, thieves make off with 18 tons of sand
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (-0.12)
Thieves in California, likely targeting valuable Nvidia AI chips, stole two trailers prominently displaying Nvidia logos. To their surprise, the trailers, belonging to autonomous trucking company PlusAI, contained 18 tons of sand used as ballast for testing, not high-value electronics. This incident highlights the growing black market for AI hardware driven by high demand, prices, and U.S. export restrictions, as evidenced by recent seizures of Nvidia graphics cards and attempts to smuggle H100 and H200 chips.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.40)] Apple Hit With $5.7 Billion Patent Verdict Over iPhone, Apple Watch Haptics
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.40)

Apple plans to challenge the ruling, stating strong disagreement with the verdict and the damages awarded.
